title: Gauntlets of Surging Accuracy

sources.title: Surge Accuracy
markers: | summary = '''Surge Accuracy''' is a passive feature that makes you more likely to hit after you action surge.

summary: After using Action Surge, add 1d4 to attack rolls for the rest of your turn. Also grants +1 on Strength saving throws.

fields.Base value: 300 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions.
